# Mitishell v1.3.3

Some fixes and QoL for font settings.

## New Features

- Settings now has separate standard and monospace font-size controls.

## Fixes

- The monospace font picker now recognizes Nerd Font families tagged `NF`, such as Maple Mono NF.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.3.3-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.3.3-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.3.3-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
